From Little Feet · Your stand's blows shrink whatever they hit.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: When your stand hits with a Strike, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to your stand until the end of your next turn as it starts to shrink (no save), and it attempts @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}: failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn; critical failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} as well, and it shrinks one size for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} for that minute). Crushing blows: your stand's Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to a creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled} from Shrink. Shrinking pinch: 1 action: your stand pinches a creature within 30 ft down to size without a Strike; the squeeze deals @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] damage, at most 2d6 (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); a failure makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled} as above (not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}), and a critical failure has the same effects as above.
  • 5: A failure's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} now lasts 1 minute, and a critical failure also makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 minute. Crushing blows deal 2d6. Surge: shrink yourself and your stand to Tiny for 10 minutes (+2 Stealth, can squeeze through any gap).
  • 9: Your surge can shrink one willing adjacent ally along with you.
  • 13: Shrinking now lasts 1 minute and stacks once more on a later hit (up to two sizes): a failure makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2}. Crushing blows deal 3d6.
  • 17: A creature that fails while already shrunk becomes Tiny and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 3} for 1 minute (incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
